headline: Health Doctor, from entry to detail
overview: Health Doctor is an AI-powered health assessment and guidance tool. Describe your symptoms or health concerns in plain language and receive thoughtful, evidence-informed guidance to help you understand your situation, know when to seek professional care, and take meaningful steps toward better health. It's not a replacement for a doctor, but a knowledgeable companion that helps you make sense of your health.
targetAudience: Users interested in wellbeing tools for personal growth and self-discovery.

keyFeatures: AI-powered health assessment based on your described symptoms and concerns
Evidence-informed guidance to help you understand your health situation
Clear indicators of when to seek professional medical care
Consultation history to track your health questions and guidance over time
tips: Be as specific as possible when describing symptoms — include duration, severity, and any relevant context
Use Health Doctor as a starting point for understanding, but always consult a real doctor for diagnosis and treatment
